verses.1:
A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah.
 Great is the LORD,
 and greatly to be praised
 in the city of our God,
 His holy mountain.
verses.2:
Beautiful in loftiness,
 the joy of all the earth,
 like the peaks of Zaphon + 48:2 Or in the far north ; the most sacred mountain of the Canaanites was Zaphon is Mount Zion,
 the city of the great King.
verses.3:
God is in her citadels;
 He has shown Himself to be a fortress.
verses.4:
For behold, the kings assembled;
 they all advanced together.
verses.5:
They saw and were astounded;
 they fled in terror.
verses.6:
Trembling seized them there,
 anguish like a woman in labor.
verses.7:
With a wind from the east
 You wrecked the ships of Tarshish. + 48:7 Or a fleet of trading ships
verses.8:
As we have heard, so we have seen
 in the city of the LORD of Hosts,
 in the city of our God:
 God will establish her forever.
 Selah
verses.9:
Within Your temple, O God,
 we contemplate Your loving devotion.
verses.11:
Mount Zion is glad,
 the daughters + 48:11 Or the villages of Judah rejoice,
 on account of Your judgments.
verses.12:
March around Zion, encircle her,
 count her towers,
verses.13:
consider her ramparts, tour her citadels,
 that you may tell the next generation.
verses.14:
For this God is our God forever and ever;
 He will be our guide even till death. + 48:14 Or He will guide us beyond death

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
